verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB is a managed database service, not an agent, so an official MCP server is an applicable axis. First-party docs describe connecting coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, VS Code, Zed) to its databases over MCP, with OAuth 2.1 auth and tools to list services, run SQL, and read monitoring. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the MCP server works as described.
